Third-party software in celv2enc.exe and the runtime files next to it
====================================================================

AVM (AV2 reference decoder library, v1.0.0)
  Statically linked. Its license and the AOMedia Patent License 1.0 are in
  third_party\avm\LICENSE and third_party\avm\PATENTS.

NVIDIA CUDA Runtime (cudart, static)
  celv2enc.exe contains the CUDA Runtime (cudart_static, CUDA Toolkit 13.3.1, cudart 13.3.29)
  and GPU code compiled with the CUDA Toolkit. These distributable parts are redistributed as
  object code inside celv2enc.exe under the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit End User License Agreement
  (EULA, section 1.1 and Attachment A, "CUDA Runtime"): https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/
  No NVIDIA DLL is shipped. The GPU driver (nvcuda.dll) comes with the user's NVIDIA driver.

Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll)
  Redistributed unchanged from Visual Studio's "VC\Redist" folder, as allowed by Microsoft's
  Visual Studio license terms for redistributable files. Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.

av2_mux.exe
  See third_party\av2-tools\ (LICENSE, PATENTS, README.txt, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt).
